# Office.com

> Microsoft 365 Copilot is Microsoft’s cloud productivity hub for creating, sharing, and collaborating across documents, presentations, email, meetings, and data.

Office.com serves as an entry point to Microsoft 365 experiences, plans, and AI-powered workflows. It connects users to Copilot, Microsoft 365 apps, business and enterprise offerings, education solutions, and collaboration tools such as Teams.

## Core Platform
- [Microsoft 365 Copilot | Create, Share and Collaborate](https://www.office.com): Main Office.com homepage for Microsoft 365 productivity, collaboration, and AI-assisted work.
- [Microsoft 365 Home](https://m365.cloud.microsoft/): Cloud landing page for accessing Microsoft 365 apps, files, and productivity experiences.
- [Microsoft Teams](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-teams/group-chat-software): Collaboration platform for chat, meetings, calling, and teamwork across organizations.

## Microsoft 365 Copilot
- [Microsoft 365 Copilot](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot): Overview of Copilot for work, including AI assistance across Microsoft 365 apps.
- [Copilot Chat](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/chat): AI chat experience for work grounded in web and organizational context.
- [AI Agents](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/agents): Information about agents that automate tasks and business processes with AI.
- [Daily Prompt Guide](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/learn-copilot-today): Prompting guidance and examples for getting more value from Copilot.
- [Copilot Plans and Pricing](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/pricing): Pricing information for Microsoft 365 Copilot offerings and licensing options.

## Home and Personal Plans
- [Compare Microsoft 365 Products](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/buy/compare-all-microsoft-365-products): Compare Microsoft 365 plans, features, and pricing for individual users.
- [Microsoft 365 Family](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/p/microsoft-365-family/cfq7ttc0k5dm): Subscription plan for families with premium apps, storage, and security features.
- [Microsoft 365 Personal](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/p/microsoft-365-personal/cfq7ttc0k5bf): Subscription plan for one person with premium productivity apps and cloud storage.
- [Microsoft 365 Premium](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/p/microsoft-365-premium/cfq7ttc11z3q): Premium Microsoft 365 offering for advanced productivity and protection features.
- [Explore Microsoft 365 for Home](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/explore-microsoft-365-for-home): Overview of Microsoft 365 benefits, apps, and scenarios for home use.

## Business
- [Microsoft 365 for Business](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/business): Overview of Microsoft 365 solutions for small and growing businesses.
- [Business Plans and Pricing](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/business/microsoft-365-plans-and-pricing): Compare Microsoft 365 business subscriptions, features, and pricing tiers.
- [Microsoft Teams for Business](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-teams/group-chat-software): Team communication and meeting platform used across business Microsoft 365 plans.

## Enterprise and Frontline
- [Microsoft 365 Enterprise](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/microsoft-365-enterprise): Enterprise productivity, security, and management solutions for large organizations.
- [Enterprise Plans and Pricing](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/enterprise/microsoft-365-plans-and-pricing): Compare Microsoft 365 enterprise plans, capabilities, and licensing options.
- [Frontline Workers](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/enterprise/frontline): Microsoft 365 solutions tailored for frontline and shift-based workforces.
- [Nonprofit Plans and Pricing](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/enterprise/nonprofit-plans-and-pricing): Microsoft 365 pricing and plan information for eligible nonprofit organizations.

## Education
- [Microsoft 365 for Education](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/education/products/microsoft-365): Education-focused Microsoft 365 offerings for schools, classrooms, and institutions.
- [Students](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/education/students): Resources and offers for students using Microsoft tools for learning and productivity.
- [Schools](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/education/products/microsoft-365): Microsoft 365 solutions for schools, including collaboration and classroom productivity tools.

## Product Areas
- [Microsoft 365 Copilot](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot): AI assistant integrated across Microsoft 365 applications and workflows.
- [Microsoft Teams](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-teams/group-chat-software): Meetings, chat, and collaboration workspace for teams and organizations.
- [Microsoft 365 for Home](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/explore-microsoft-365-for-home): Consumer productivity suite for documents, presentations, email, and storage.
- [Microsoft 365 for Business](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/business): Business productivity suite with collaboration, security, and device management capabilities.

## Pricing and Plan Comparison
- [Compare Microsoft 365 Products](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/buy/compare-all-microsoft-365-products): Side-by-side comparison of Microsoft 365 consumer plans and included features.
- [Business Plans and Pricing](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/business/microsoft-365-plans-and-pricing): Pricing comparison for Microsoft 365 business subscriptions and services.
- [Enterprise Plans and Pricing](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/enterprise/microsoft-365-plans-and-pricing): Pricing comparison for enterprise Microsoft 365 plans and capabilities.
- [Copilot Plans and Pricing](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/pricing): Licensing and pricing details for Microsoft 365 Copilot offerings.
- [Nonprofit Plans and Pricing](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/enterprise/nonprofit-plans-and-pricing): Discounted Microsoft 365 plan information for nonprofit organizations.

## Audience-Specific Entry Points
- [For Families](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/p/microsoft-365-family/cfq7ttc0k5dm): Microsoft 365 subscription designed for households and shared use.
- [For Single Users](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/p/microsoft-365-personal/cfq7ttc0k5bf): Microsoft 365 subscription intended for one individual user.
- [For Premium Users](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/p/microsoft-365-premium/cfq7ttc11z3q): Premium Microsoft 365 plan for enhanced productivity and protection.
- [For Small Business](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/business): Microsoft 365 solutions for small business productivity and collaboration.
- [For Enterprise](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/microsoft-365-enterprise): Microsoft 365 solutions for large organizations and complex IT environments.
- [For Frontline Workers](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/enterprise/frontline): Productivity and communication tools for frontline employees.
- [For Students](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/education/students): Student-focused Microsoft education resources and offers.
- [For Schools](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/education/products/microsoft-365): Microsoft 365 education solutions for schools and educators.
